summary: Invokes FunctionCallWrapper on this, then conditionally calls FreeWrapper when flag bit 0 of the second argument is set. Returns this unchanged.

operations.description: Call FunctionCallWrapper_9440 with this as its argument.
Guard on (a2 & 1) != 0 controlling whether the object is released.
Call FreeWrapper_7bcf with this as its argument when the guard passes.
